targets.old_statement: A Notice of Action on Form I-797 counts as lawful status proof when the BMV confirms DHS has received it and not denied the action.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A Notice of Action on Form I-seven hundred ninety-seven counts as lawful status proof when the BMV confirms DHS has received it and not denied the action.
targets.statement: A Notice of Action form proves lawful status only if the BMV verifies that DHS received it without denying action and the applicant also submits pertaining federal-agency documents showing lawful status.
